Available sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], '''''Attack of the Clones''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] that depicted individuals involved in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. It portrayed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and various [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Droid/Legends|war machines]].

==Description==
The [[Painting/Legends|painting]] ''Attack of the Clones'' depicted individuals and groups that were involved in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This included [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. The painting also depicted [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] engaged in battle with [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==History==
One of many paintings and other pieces of art available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], ''Attack of the Clones'' was most prevalent during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The painting appeared sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and was a pivotal conflict in the war.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Attack of the Clones'' was an obtainable painting in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players could acquire the painting with one "Buddy Token"&mdash;an in-game currency rewarded to those who invited new players to be ''Star Wars Galaxies'' subscribers&mdash;and use it in their house as decoration.<ref name="SWG" /> The in-game image is a cropped version of the theatrical poster for the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" />
